nodes.text: Danas me čeka naporan dan. Nakon njega ostaje mi još samo jedan dan slobode pa ponovno postajem samo broj pacijenta, a ne slobodan čovjek!

nodes.source: Relaxed for the afternoon, tiredness still catching up with me. Went out to pick up my suit, got changed and went to my Masonic Lodge supper meeting. Made it home quite early, got changed again and relaxed in front of the TV.
nodes.text: Poslijepodne sam se odmarao jer me umor još sustiže. Otišao sam po odijelo, presvukao se i prisustvovao večernjem sastanku masonske lože uz večeru. Kući sam se vratio prilično rano, opet se presvukao i opustio pred televizorom.

nodes.source: Ahhhh, I sat up really late again tonight and promised myself I would try to get to bed early. Goodnight.
nodes.text: Ahhh, opet sam ostao budan do kasno, iako sam sebi obećao da ću rano leći. Laku noć.

nodes.source: 30th January 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 30. siječnja 2005. - nedjelja

nodes.source: Slept well despite getting to bed quite late indeed.
nodes.text: Dobro sam spavao unatoč vrlo kasnom odlasku u krevet.

nodes.source: Had breakfast at a reasonable time and trying my best to get in shape for next weeks chemo battering.
nodes.text: Doručkovao sam u razumno vrijeme i dajem sve od sebe da se pripremim za udarce kemoterapije sljedećeg tjedna.

nodes.source: Off to my Mums for a bit and then to a friends house for dinner. Only saw my Mum briefly today, although I would have liked to spend more time, I couldn't bare to see her lying in bed, stiff with Parkinson's and depressed with nothing much to look forward to. At the start of all this, I asked my Brother kindly to spend a little more time with her as he only lives 10 minutes away. His visits have really been only for necessity and few and far between. I asked her if she knew when he would be next visiting and she had no idea. Another stress I could do without, especially when I'm back in to hospital tomorrow for the week.
nodes.text: Idem nakratko mami, a zatim prijatelju na večeru. Danas sam mamu vidio samo kratko, iako bih volio ostati dulje. Teško mi je bilo gledati je kako leži u krevetu, ukočena zbog Parkinsonove bolesti i potištena jer nema mnogo čemu se veseliti. Kad je sve ovo počelo, ljubazno sam zamolio brata da s njom provodi malo više vremena jer živi samo deset minuta dalje. Njegovi posjeti, koliko znam, bili su rijetki i uglavnom samo kad je nešto trebalo. Pitao sam mamu zna li kad će je sljedeći put posjetiti i nije imala pojma. Još jedan stres koji mi ne treba, osobito kad se sutra ponovno vraćam u bolnicu na cijeli tjedan.

nodes.source: Had a really nice meal and a chat at my friends house and headed off home to get ready for tomorrow.
nodes.text: Kod prijatelja sam imao jako dobar obrok i razgovor pa krenuo kući spremati se za sutra.

nodes.source: Developed a bit of a headache this evening, going to get that much needed sleep now. Night.
nodes.text: Večeras me malo zaboljela glava. Idem uhvatiti prijeko potreban san. Laku noć.

nodes.source: 31st January 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 31. siječnja 2005. - ponedjeljak

nodes.source: Another month almost over! Slept well.
nodes.text: Još jedan mjesec gotovo je završio! Dobro sam spavao.

nodes.source: Getting all my stuff together for my week in hospital, I doubt very much they will be ready for me in any way whatsoever. Once I arrive I should have a blood test, X-ray and then start my chemotherapy.
nodes.text: Skupljam sve stvari za tjedan dana u bolnici. Sumnjam da će oni biti spremni za mene u bilo kojem pogledu. Kad stignem, trebali bi mi izvaditi krv, snimiti rendgen i početi kemoterapiju.

nodes.source: Arrived at the Hospital, bed allocated immediately (6th Floor, West, F4) and bloods taken. Hopefully going for an X-ray soon, then getting ready for first round of chemotherapy (15 hours).
nodes.text: Stigao sam u bolnicu, odmah su mi dodijelili krevet na šestom katu, zapadni odjel, F4, i izvadili krv. Nadam se da ću uskoro na rendgen, a zatim slijedi prva petnaestosatna kemoterapija.

nodes.source: Had my X-ray, I got a look but will not comment until the Consultant has seen it. Now the long wait for chemotherapy drugs to arrive, everyone on my ward is waiting for their chemotherapy to start, it'll be a mad dash when they bring it.
nodes.text: Snimio sam rendgen i vidio snimku, ali neću komentirati dok je specijalist ne pregleda. Sada dugo čekamo da stignu kemoterapijski lijekovi. Svi na odjelu čekaju početak terapije pa će biti prava strka kad ih donesu.

nodes.source: chemotherapy started at 19.20 so all being well it will finish at around 12.00 tomorrow, allowing for bag changes and nursing/staff levels. Cannulation experience was fine (thanks Emla cream and nurse Auxilia) although I'm running out of veins for them to feed me, this time its located around the back of my left forearm.
nodes.text: Kemoterapija je počela u 19:20, pa bi, ako sve bude dobro, trebala završiti sutra oko podneva, ovisno o zamjenama vrećica i broju osoblja. Postavljanje kanile prošlo je dobro, hvala kremi Emla i sestri Auxiliji, iako mi ponestaje vena u koje mogu davati lijekove. Ovaj put je na stražnjoj strani lijeve podlaktice.

nodes.source: Consultant has been round to see me and has passed comments on my X-ray. I am now half way through my overall treatment schedule and embarking on the second half this week. My recent X-ray is better but still showing some small evidence of Cancerous lesions, hopefully with the second half of my treatment they will clear and with the figures heading the way they have been there is no reason why they shouldn't (along with a lot of positive thinking on my behalf and all your good wishes I'll beat this Cancer in to non existence).
nodes.text: Specijalist me posjetio i komentirao rendgen. Sad sam na polovici cjelokupnog liječenja i ovoga tjedna ulazim u drugu polovicu. Nova snimka bolja je, ali još se vide male promjene koje upućuju na rak. Nadam se da će ih druga polovica terapije očistiti. S obzirom na dosadašnje nalaze, nema razloga da ne bude tako, uz moje pozitivno razmišljanje i sve vaše dobre želje. Istjerat ću taj rak iz postojanja.

nodes.source: IF
nodes.text: AKO

nodes.source: it doesn't clear from my lungs, there is a chance that I may have to be operated on, not only on my testicle but possibly my abdomen and my lungs!! A daunting thought indeed.
nodes.text: ne nestane iz pluća, možda ću trebati operaciju ne samo testisa nego i trbuha, a moguće i pluća!! Zaista zastrašujuća pomisao.

nodes.source: The testicle operation is expected and for definite, the others based on my recovery. So I'll keep positive and hope that I have enough of you out there keeping everything crossed for me!
nodes.text: Operacija testisa je očekivana i sigurna, ostale ovise o oporavku. Zato ću ostati pozitivan i nadati se da svi držite palčeve za mene!

nodes.source: Feeling fine tonight, had a few unexpected visitors which was very nice indeed. I'll say goodnight for tonight and be thinking of you all tucked up asleep whilst I am being pumped full of chemo through the night.
nodes.text: Večeras se osjećam dobro. Imao sam nekoliko neočekivanih posjetitelja, što je bilo zaista lijepo. Sada vam želim laku noć i mislit ću na vas kako spokojno spavate dok mene cijelu noć pune kemoterapijom.

nodes.source: As I said this morning, the month is now over, time to embark on another, my time of recovery and freedom from this disease draws closer and closer all the time.
nodes.text: Kao što sam jutros rekao, mjesec je završio. Vrijeme je za novi, a vrijeme mojeg oporavka i slobode od ove bolesti stalno je sve bliže.

nodes.source: February 2005
nodes.text: veljača 2005.

nodes.source: 1st February 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 1. veljače 2005. - utorak

nodes.source: Very disturbed sleep last night, as I expected really. Still tired and groggy this morning, so I'm not up to much. Feeling hungry, so I should get up and go get some breakfast.
nodes.text: Sinoć sam vrlo nemirno spavao, kao što sam i očekivao. Jutros sam još umoran i omamljen pa nisam za mnogo toga. Gladan sam, zato bih trebao ustati i otići doručkovati.

nodes.source: I'll only have a short break from chemotherapy today. Not the 'required' 24 hours between treatments, just 4 hours. If I work it this way, at least my body will be given a 'reasonable' amount of time to recover between treatments each day and I will get a relatively undisturbed sleep with the mornings to myself, free of the IV machine. In theory this sounds great, let's see if I can make it work this week. I'm only trying to make it better based on my previous rushed chemotherapy experience.
nodes.text: Danas ću imati samo kratku stanku od kemoterapije. Ne propisana 24 sata između doza, nego tek četiri sata. Ako uspijem tako organizirati raspored, tijelo će ipak imati 'razumno' vrijeme za oporavak svakoga dana, a ja ću noću moći relativno neometano spavati i jutra provoditi bez infuzijskog aparata. U teoriji zvuči izvrsno, vidjet ćemo hoće li funkcionirati ovoga tjedna. Samo pokušavam poboljšati iskustvo nakon prošlog požurivanog ciklusa.

nodes.source: I managed some Weetabix and a brief visit over to Milton's ward.
nodes.text: Uspio sam pojesti Weetabix i nakratko posjetiti Miltonov odjel.

nodes.source: The day went in a blur, had a quite a few visitors but was not feeling my best and spent most of the day in bed feeling poorly. I was sick a tiny bit, too.
nodes.text: Dan je prošao kao kroz maglu. Imao sam dosta posjetitelja, ali nisam se osjećao dobro i većinu dana proveo sam u krevetu bolestan. Malo sam i povraćao.

nodes.source: Chemotherapy started at 5pm.
nodes.text: Kemoterapija je počela u 17 sati.

nodes.source: By the evening I'd had no lunch, no dinner and was still feeling sick and weak.
nodes.text: Do večeri nisam pojeo ni ručak ni večeru, a i dalje mi je bilo mučno i osjećao sam slabost.

nodes.source: I fancied a bowl of mixed fruit and Ken kindly went in to the kitchen and prepared a load for me. This went down really well and I soon perked up. Watched a DVD (Paycheck) to while away the early hours while chemo finished and then got my head down for a reasonable sleep.
nodes.text: Zaželio sam zdjelu miješanog voća i Ken je ljubazno otišao u kuhinju te mi pripremio veliku porciju. To mi je dobro sjelo i brzo sam živnuo. Pogledao sam DVD 'Paycheck' da mi prođu rani jutarnji sati dok kemoterapija ne završi, pa sam legao na spavanje.

nodes.source: To give you an idea of how poorly I felt today, I hardly touched my computer and haven't updated my diary for some time.
nodes.text: Da shvatite koliko mi je danas bilo loše: jedva sam taknuo računalo i već neko vrijeme nisam ažurirao dnevnik.

nodes.source: 2nd February 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 2. veljače 2005. - srijeda

nodes.source: A good night's sleep, feeling a little better today although still a little dodgy. I'm not sure what it is, maybe sickness, maybe hunger, maybe fatigue, I cannot quite put my finger on it.
nodes.text: Dobro sam spavao i danas mi je malo bolje, premda se još osjećam čudno. Ne znam je li to mučnina, glad ili umor, jednostavno ne mogu odrediti.

nodes.source: My Consultant paid me another brief visit today, not much to say really. I mentioned I was a little concerned about this news that I may have to have an operation on my lungs, but he kind of reassured me that in most cases they do not expect to carry this out and he pointed out again that I was only half way through my treatment.
nodes.text: Specijalist me danas nakratko posjetio. Nismo imali mnogo o čemu razgovarati. Spomenuo sam zabrinutost zbog mogućnosti operacije pluća, ali me donekle umirio rekavši da je u većini slučajeva ne očekuju i ponovno me podsjetio da sam tek na polovici liječenja.

nodes.source: Still it all has to be said 'just in case' and the abdomen operation was mentioned as well. I've just got to keep fighting mentally to get rid of this Cancer from my body and just have the one operation to remove the affected testicle.
nodes.text: Ipak, sve te mogućnosti moraju spomenuti 'za svaki slučaj', kao i operaciju trbuha. Moram se nastaviti psihički boriti da rak potpuno nestane iz tijela i da jedina operacija bude uklanjanje zahvaćenog testisa.

nodes.source: Well, if I feel up to it later today, I'll update you all a bit more, until then...
nodes.text: Ako se poslije budem osjećao dovoljno dobro, javit ću vam još novosti. Dotad...

nodes.source: Chemotherapy started at 15:00 today. All being well I should be finished around midnight.
nodes.text: Kemoterapija je danas počela u 15 sati. Ako sve bude dobro, završit ću oko ponoći.

nodes.source: Had an aromatherapy back massage this afternoon, a much looked forward to complimentary therapy which takes me away from the stresses and strains of hospital life.
nodes.text: Poslijepodne sam dobio aromaterapijsku masažu leđa, dodatnu terapiju kojoj sam se jako veselio jer me nakratko odvela od stresa i napetosti bolničkog života.

nodes.source: Feeling a bit better, I can smell dinner and will try to get some of it inside me now. Managed most of my dinner.
nodes.text: Osjećam se malo bolje, mirišem večeru pa ću pokušati nešto pojesti. Uspio sam pojesti gotovo sve.

nodes.source: Quite a few visitors came tonight which tired me out somewhat. Chemotherapy carried on into the early hours and the ward was noisy tonight so sleep will be difficult.
nodes.text: Večeras je bilo dosta posjetitelja, što me pomalo iscrpilo. Kemoterapija se nastavila u rane jutarnje sate, a odjel je bio bučan pa će spavanje biti teško.

nodes.source: 3rd February 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 3. veljače 2005. - četvrtak

nodes.source: Woke after a very disturbed sleep. Managed to get up for some breakfast.
nodes.text: Probudio sam se nakon vrlo isprekidane noći, ali uspio ustati na doručak.

nodes.source: The rest of the day I spent in bed, feeling very nauseous. On occasion, mostly when I went in to the very 'unclean' and smelly patient toilet on my ward, this would cause me to heave and sometimes to be sick.
nodes.text: Ostatak dana proveo sam u krevetu s jakom mučninom. Povremeno, osobito kad bih ušao u vrlo prljav i smrdljiv zahod za pacijente na odjelu, počeo bih se grčiti od gađenja i ponekad povraćati.

nodes.source: Couldn't face any lunch.
nodes.text: Ručak nisam mogao ni pogledati.

nodes.source: Chemotherapy started at around the same time as yesterday, possibly a little earlier in order for me to be free earlier for sleep. I wasn't aware of much, I had my good moments, mostly after being sick but it soon turned bad again and I was in and out of sleep all day.
nodes.text: Kemoterapija je počela otprilike u isto vrijeme kao jučer, možda malo ranije kako bih prije završio i mogao spavati. Nisam bio svjestan mnogo toga. Imao sam dobre trenutke, uglavnom nakon povraćanja, ali brzo bi mi opet pozlilo. Cijeli sam dan naizmjenično spavao i budio se.

nodes.source: This week so far has been much harder than previous weeks. A female friend has been to see me several times this week, the female company with a little added TLC has really made all the difference.
nodes.text: Ovaj je tjedan zasad mnogo teži od prethodnih. Prijateljica me nekoliko puta posjetila i žensko društvo uz malo dodatne njege i nježnosti stvarno je učinilo veliku razliku.

nodes.source: Couldn't face any dinner. Ken prepared another plate of fruit for me, which I ate most of and managed to digest before being sick again later on!
nodes.text: Večeru nisam mogao ni pogledati. Ken mi je pripremio još jedan tanjur voća. Većinu sam pojeo i uspio probaviti prije nego što sam kasnije ponovno povratio!

nodes.source: Developed a mild headache and was given 500mg of Paracetamol.
nodes.text: Dobio sam blagu glavobolju i dali su mi 500 mg paracetamola.

nodes.source: Got free of the chemotherapy drip at a reasonable hour and got my head down for as best a night's sleep as I could muster. During the night I woke feeling nauseous, I hadn't taken my anti sickness tablets from earlier, so stayed awake for a while until I felt like I could manage a sip of water and got the tablets inside me, 2 Domperidome and 1 Ciprofloxacin.
nodes.text: S infuzije kemoterapije skinuli su me u razumno vrijeme pa sam legao pokušati što bolje spavati. Tijekom noći probudio sam se s mučninom. Ranije nisam popio lijekove protiv nje pa sam neko vrijeme ostao budan dok nisam mogao gutnuti vode i uzeti tablete, dvije domperidona i jednu ciprofloksacina.

nodes.source: 4th February 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 4. veljače 2005. - petak

nodes.source: Woke up feeling a little better and managed a bowl of cornflakes. This feeling didn't last long and I retired to bed feeling much the same as the previous day.
nodes.text: Probudio sam se osjećajući se malo bolje i uspio pojesti zdjelu kukuruznih pahuljica. Taj osjećaj nije dugo potrajao pa sam se vratio u krevet, gotovo jednako loše kao jučer.

nodes.source: Couldn't face lunch.
nodes.text: Ručak nisam mogao ni pogledati.

nodes.source: The day went slowly, chemotherapy started late although I had agreed to have it started earlier.
nodes.text: Dan je prolazio sporo. Kemoterapija je počela kasno, iako sam se dogovorio da počne ranije.

nodes.source: Couldn't face dinner.
nodes.text: Ni večeru nisam mogao ni pogledati.

nodes.source: Finally got away for home at 22.00. Once home I had a bath and went to bed!
nodes.text: Napokon sam u 22 sata otišao kući. Kod kuće sam se okupao i otišao u krevet!

nodes.source: 5th February 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 5. veljače 2005. - subota

nodes.source: Woke up after a long and undisturbed sleep. Felt much better than any of the mornings last week.
nodes.text: Probudio sam se nakon dugog, neprekinutog sna. Osjećao sam se bolje nego bilo kojeg jutra prošlog tjedna.

nodes.source: Managed some breakfast and took my correct medication, 1 Granisetron and 2 Domperidome tablets.
nodes.text: Uspio sam doručkovati i uzeo propisane lijekove: jednu tabletu granisetrona i dvije domperidona.

nodes.source: A friend popped over and I decided (after a little convincing) to go out locally for a Pizza Express. Ken, my friend and I hit the Hampton Court Pizza Express for a little while. I managed a bit of a starter and the majority of my main course. Straight home after.
nodes.text: Prijateljica je navratila i nakon malo nagovaranja odlučio sam izići u obližnji Pizza Express. Ken, prijateljica i ja otišli smo u Pizza Express kod Hampton Courta na kratko druženje. Uspio sam pojesti malo predjela i većinu glavnog jela, a zatim odmah kući.

nodes.source: Just been relaxing for the rest of the day, haven't really been hungry but feeling much better. Managed to update this diary with entries for the past few days.
nodes.text: Ostatak dana samo sam se odmarao. Nisam bio osobito gladan, ali osjećam se mnogo bolje. Uspio sam ažurirati dnevnik zapisima za posljednjih nekoliko dana.

nodes.source: This evening I've had another mild headache, so I've taken another 500mg of Paracetamol which seems to have done the trick.
nodes.text: Večeras sam imao još jednu blagu glavobolju pa sam popio 500 mg paracetamola, što je izgleda pomoglo.

nodes.source: Not sure if I'll have a snack or not tonight. I'm going to concentrate on trying to eat a little something before I go to bed. I think my body is looking forward more to another long and undisturbed sleep instead of food!
nodes.text: Još ne znam hoću li večeras nešto prigristi. Pokušat ću barem malo pojesti prije spavanja. Mislim da se tijelo više veseli još jednoj dugoj, mirnoj noći nego hrani!

nodes.source: Until tomorrow...
nodes.text: Do sutra...

nodes.source: 6th February 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 6. veljače 2005. - nedjelja

nodes.source: Another long sleep and a very lazy morning lying in bed. Felt OK when I woke, although a little nauseous, or perhaps hungry, I couldn't determine which.
nodes.text: Još jedan dugi san i vrlo lijeno jutro u krevetu. Kad sam se probudio, bilo mi je dobro, premda mi je bilo malo mučno ili sam možda bio gladan. Nisam mogao odrediti.

nodes.source: I've taken my medication (1 Granisetron and 2 Domperidome tablets) late today (about 14.00) and haven't eaten as yet.
nodes.text: Danas sam lijekove, jednu tabletu granisetrona i dvije domperidona, uzeo kasno, oko 14 sati, a još ništa nisam pojeo.

nodes.source: Not planning anything today apart from possibly going over to see my Mum later on this evening if I feel up to it. Apparently she's been invited out at last however, if she cannot make it, I'm sure she'll be left indoors alone with no family visits. The only local family she has apart from me is my brother and it's really been playing on my mind on how much he has been looking out for her whilst I have been unable to. Not a lot by all accounts.
nodes.text: Danas ne planiram ništa osim možda navečer otići do mame ako budem imao snage. Navodno je napokon pozvana nekamo u goste, ali ako ne može otići, bojim se da će ostati sama kod kuće bez obiteljskih posjeta. Jedina bliža obitelj koju ovdje ima, osim mene, jest moj brat, i sve me više muči koliko se on brinuo o njoj dok ja nisam mogao. Prema svemu sudeći, ne mnogo.

nodes.source: Had a little something to eat for an early dinner.
nodes.text: Za ranu večeru pojeo sam nešto malo.

nodes.source: Went over to see my Mum this evening for a few hours. I arrived to find her well and downstairs but her cheek was all swollen on one side. This has happened before, possibly an abscess. It took me a while to convince her to make sure she again calls the Doctor about this as soon as possible, despite an upcoming X-Ray appointment, she has been waiting three months for! I have seen so much varied Cancer at the hospital on both young and old, male and female, it frightens me to think what the outcome of my Mum's X-Ray will bring.
nodes.text: Večeras sam nekoliko sati proveo kod mame. Kad sam stigao, bila je dobro i dolje u dnevnoj sobi, ali jedna strana obraza bila joj je sva otečena. To se već dogodilo, možda je apsces. Trebalo mi je vremena da je uvjerim da što prije opet nazove liječnika, iako ima zakazano rendgensko snimanje na koje čeka već tri mjeseca! U bolnici sam vidio toliko različitih oblika raka, kod mladih i starih, žena i muškaraca, da me strah pomisliti što bi mamin rendgen mogao pokazati.

nodes.source: Despite my treatment going very well, this weekend is the first time I have had thoughts such as "will I make it to see the end of this year", stupid I know but I want to be totally honest here in this diary. Guess I'm just scared and this past week has taken its toll on me mentally as well as physically.
nodes.text: Iako liječenje ide vrlo dobro, ovog sam vikenda prvi put pomislio: 'Hoću li doživjeti kraj ove godine?' Znam da zvuči glupo, ali želim biti potpuno iskren u dnevniku. Valjda se samo bojim, a prošli tjedan me iscrpio i psihički i fizički.

nodes.source: I returned home, made myself a little more to eat and relaxed in front of the TV until the early hours. During the course of the evening that mild headache crept back up on me for what must be the third night running, I'm not sure what's causing them? Another 500mg of Paracetamol and I went to bed.
nodes.text: Vratio sam se kući, pripremio si još malo hrane i odmarao se uz televiziju do ranih jutarnjih sati. Tijekom večeri ponovno se pojavila blaga glavobolja, valjda treću noć zaredom. Ne znam što je uzrokuje. Popio sam još 500 mg paracetamola i otišao u krevet.

nodes.source: 7th February 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 7. veljače 2005. - ponedjeljak

nodes.source: Woke up feeling fine and hungry this morning. Quite early (09:30) considering I didn't go to bed until 02:30. Hopefully that'll mean an early night tonight, in readiness for treatment tomorrow.
nodes.text: Jutros sam se probudio dobro raspoložen i gladan. Prilično rano, u 9:30, s obzirom na to da sam legao tek u 2:30. Nadam se da ću večeras ranije zaspati i biti spreman za sutrašnju terapiju.

nodes.source: Managed some cleaning around my house, had a visit from a good friend and then a bite to eat, off to the supermarket and briefly to my Mum's house again.
nodes.text: Uspio sam malo očistiti kuću, posjetio me dobar prijatelj, nešto sam pojeo, otišao u supermarket i nakratko ponovno svratio do mame.

nodes.source: I feel almost normal today! Unfortunately it doesn't last long, I'm getting very tired quickly these days and it's treatment day tomorrow.
nodes.text: Danas se osjećam gotovo normalno! Nažalost, to ne traje dugo. Ovih dana brzo se jako umaram, a sutra je ponovno dan za terapiju.

nodes.source: Had a blow-out dinner this evening which Ken kindly prepared for me.
nodes.text: Večeras sam uživao u obilnoj večeri koju mi je Ken ljubazno pripremio.

nodes.source: Off to bed soon, dreaded hospital day tomorrow.
nodes.text: Uskoro idem spavati. Sutra opet onaj mrski dan u bolnici.

nodes.source: 8th February 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 8. veljače 2005. - utorak

nodes.source: Felt really exhausted when I woke up today. Blew my nose before getting ready and developed a nose bleed, this is a worry especially when my platelets could be low. I managed to stop it quite quickly but it worried me somewhat. After a quick breakfast, Ken and I braved the traffic to the hospital, it wasn't very easy today, the roads were full.
nodes.text: Jutros sam se probudio potpuno iscrpljen. Kad sam ispuhnuo nos prije spremanja, počela mi je teći krv iz nosa. To me zabrinulo jer bi mi trombociti mogli biti niski. Krvarenje sam brzo zaustavio, ali ostao sam uznemiren. Nakon brzog doručka Ken i ja krenuli smo kroz promet prema bolnici; danas nije bilo lako, ceste su bile pune.

nodes.source: These problems I had this morning caused me to arrive at the Hospital quite late. My blood test was taken almost immediately, but due to my unavoidable lateness there was insufficient time to squeeze in receiving my blood results along with my 6 hours of chemotherapy. Therefore it was decided that it would be best all round to have my chemotherapy treatment postponed until tomorrow.
nodes.text: Zbog jutrošnjih problema stigao sam u bolnicu prilično kasno. Krv su mi izvadili gotovo odmah, ali zbog neizbježnog kašnjenja nije bilo dovoljno vremena i za nalaze i za šest sati kemoterapije. Odlučili smo da je najbolje odgoditi terapiju do sutra.

nodes.source: One day off schedule will not however make any difference to my health stakes.
nodes.text: Jedan dan odstupanja od rasporeda neće utjecati na moje izglede za zdravlje.

nodes.source: Once my blood test results were back it appeared that my earlier worry of a low platelet count was in fact unfounded. It turns out they have risen back to completely normal levels for the moment. However, and confirming my tiredness of this morning, my red blood count and haemoglobin levels are starting to fall in to the "we're concerned" range. A possible blood transfusion was mentioned! I will now be watching these levels carefully along with all the other counts from my blood tests that I have so far learned about.
nodes.text: Kad su krvni nalazi stigli, pokazalo se da je moja zabrinutost zbog niskih trombocita bila neutemeljena. Trenutačno su se vratili na sasvim normalne vrijednosti. Međutim, potvrđujući jutrošnji umor, broj crvenih krvnih stanica i razina hemoglobina počinju padati u područje koje liječnike zabrinjava. Spomenuta je moguća transfuzija krvi! Sada ću pomno pratiti te vrijednosti, kao i sve ostale pokazatelje krvne slike koje sam dosad naučio razumjeti.

nodes.source: In order to maximise my time at the hospital, it was arranged that an upcoming EDTA test be moved forward to today. This meant a bit of necessary hanging around and I was out of the Hospital by 16:30.
nodes.text: Da bismo što bolje iskoristili boravak u bolnici, dogovorili smo da se predstojeća EDTA pretraga obavi već danas. To je značilo još malo čekanja, a iz bolnice sam izašao do 16:30.

nodes.source: Straight home for a huge dinner kindly prepared by Ken and several pancakes for afters! I've been quite tired all day and once dinner had suitably gone down I got myself an early night in readiness for hospital tomorrow.
nodes.text: Ravno kući na golemu večeru koju je Ken ljubazno pripremio, a za desert nekoliko palačinki! Cijeli dan sam umoran pa sam, čim se večera slegla, rano otišao spavati kako bih bio spreman za sutrašnji odlazak u bolnicu.

nodes.source: 9th February 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 9. veljače 2005. - srijeda

nodes.source: Awoke still feeling tired. Although it was hard, I managed to motivate myself to get up and get ready for hospital. I had a clear 8 hours sleep last night but I'm still tired.
nodes.text: Probudio sam se još uvijek umoran. Teško sam se natjerao ustati i spremiti za bolnicu. Sinoć sam neprekinuto spavao osam sati, ali sam i dalje iscrpljen.

nodes.source: Got to the hospital, no time for Emla cream today, straight into cannulation which took 3 attempts to take this morning.
nodes.text: Stigao sam u bolnicu. Danas nije bilo vremena za kremu Emla pa su odmah pokušali postaviti kanilu, što je jutros uspjelo tek iz trećeg pokušaja.

nodes.source: Once my treatment was under way I was feeling quite a chill and asked the nurse to cover me with blankets. Managed to doze off for practically the rest of the day until my 6 hour treatment was finished.
nodes.text: Kad je terapija počela, osjećao sam priličnu hladnoću i zamolio sestru da me pokrije dekama. Uspio sam zadrijemati i praktički prespavao ostatak dana, sve dok nije završila šestosatna terapija.

nodes.source: So much sleep! Has to be down to the fact that I have a very low red blood count and haemoglobin level.
nodes.text: Toliko spavanja! Sigurno je to zbog vrlo niskog broja crvenih krvnih stanica i hemoglobina.

nodes.source: Once home, hit the sofa for more sleep! I haven't managed much to eat tonight and will soon retire to bed. Hopefully tomorrow I will be a little livelier as I have a plane to catch in the evening.
nodes.text: Kad sam stigao kući, odmah na kauč po još sna! Večeras nisam mnogo jeo i uskoro ću u krevet. Nadam se da ću sutra biti živahniji jer me navečer čeka avion.

nodes.source: Night.
nodes.text: Laku noć.

nodes.source: 10th February 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 10. veljače 2005. - četvrtak

nodes.source: Woke up after a good night's sleep and feeling much better than yesterday. A lot of things to do today.
nodes.text: Probudio sam se nakon dobre noći i osjećam se mnogo bolje nego jučer. Danas imam dosta obaveza.

nodes.source: Yesterday I left the hospital in a daze tired and exhausted; and forgot to pick up my GCSF injections from the hospital pharmacy. I need to start these injections today so another visit to the hospital is required.
nodes.text: Jučer sam iz bolnice izašao umoran i ošamućen pa sam zaboravio podići G-CSF injekcije u bolničkoj ljekarni. Danas ih moram početi primati, što znači još jedan odlazak u bolnicu.

nodes.source: Managed to complete a little work on a laptop this morning, it's ready to drop off to the owner now so I can fit that in today along with the visit to the hospital, dropping in to see my Mum and catching the plane tonight!
nodes.text: Jutros sam uspio završiti neki posao na prijenosnom računalu. Spremno je za predaju vlasniku pa ću i to danas ubaciti među odlazak u bolnicu, posjet mami i večerašnji let!

nodes.source: Ken came along with me today although I did most of the driving; managed to pickup my injections, drop off the laptop (took my first injection at this point) and get home just in time to eat and get ready for my flight.
nodes.text: Ken je danas pošao sa mnom, premda sam većinom ja vozio. Uspio sam podići injekcije, predati računalo i pri tome primiti prvu injekciju, a zatim se vratiti kući baš na vrijeme da pojedem i pripremim se za let.

nodes.source: Picked up some more clothes from my Mum's house en route to the airport.
nodes.text: Usput do zračne luke svratio sam do mame po još odjeće.

nodes.source: Arrived at Heathrow in good time for my flight only to find out it had been cancelled (supposed technical problems)! They offered to fly me to Manchester and coach me to Leeds/Bradford (my original destination). I called my friends in Leeds and it made little difference to their travel time to pick me up from either airport, so Manchester it was.
nodes.text: Na Heathrow sam stigao na vrijeme, samo da bih doznao da je let otkazan, navodno zbog tehničkih problema! Ponudili su mi let do Manchestera i autobusni prijevoz do Leedsa/Bradforda, mojeg izvornog odredišta. Nazvao sam prijatelje u Leedsu i nije im puno značilo s koje će me zračne luke pokupiti, pa je Manchester bio sasvim u redu.

nodes.source: Didn't expect any problems flying, although the walk to the gate tired me out. I had a brief wait to catch my breath as the plane was a little late in departing.
nodes.text: Nisam očekivao probleme s letenjem, iako me hodanje do izlaza za ukrcaj iscrpilo. Nakratko sam zastao doći do daha jer je polazak ionako malo kasnio.

nodes.source: Domestic flights are so quick, as soon as you have ascended it seems that you begin descent and final approach.
nodes.text: Domaći letovi traju tako kratko da, čim se popneš na visinu, već počinje spuštanje i prilaz za slijetanje.

nodes.source: My friends were waiting for me as soon as I appeared through the arrival doors and we were on our way to Leeds in a flash.
nodes.text: Prijatelji su me čekali čim sam izišao kroz dolazna vrata i začas smo bili na putu prema Leedsu.

nodes.source: Relaxed and chatted for a bit, got to bed about 01:00.
nodes.text: Malo smo se odmarali i razgovarali. U krevet sam otišao oko jedan ujutro.

nodes.source: 11th February 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 11. veljače 2005. - petak

nodes.source: Had a really nice sleep and a lazy morning.
nodes.text: Jako sam lijepo spavao i imao lijeno jutro.

nodes.source: A nice breakfast and some really tasty soup for lunch. My appetite seems to have returned quite adequately.
nodes.text: Lijep doručak i vrlo ukusna juha za ručak. Čini se da mi se apetit sasvim dobro vratio.

nodes.source: Went for a drive in and around Leeds for a while to get out for a bit. I am still feeling quite tired and not really motivated for much at all, one of the reasons I haven't updated my diary in a couple of days.
nodes.text: Malo smo se vozili Leedsom i okolicom kako bih izišao iz kuće. I dalje sam prilično umoran i nemam volje za gotovo ništa, što je jedan od razloga što nekoliko dana nisam ažurirao dnevnik.

nodes.source: Returned back to base for the second of my GCSF injections which I did myself! Chose the stomach location and managed to stick myself with the needle. It wasn't too pleasant to do but needs must!
nodes.text: Vratili smo se kući na drugu G-CSF injekciju, koju sam dao sam sebi! Odabrao sam trbuh i uspio se ubosti iglom. Nije bilo osobito ugodno, ali što se mora, mora se!

nodes.source: Had a wonderful dinner, watched the box, relaxed and chatted for most of the evening.
nodes.text: Divno sam večerao, gledao televiziju, odmarao se i razgovarao gotovo cijelu večer.

nodes.source: After a bath I got to bed around 00.00.
nodes.text: Nakon kupanja legao sam oko ponoći.

nodes.source: 12th February 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 12. veljače 2005. - subota

nodes.source: Another good sleep and a lazy morning. I've had breakfast so the appetite is still there.
nodes.text: Još jedna dobra noć i lijeno jutro. Doručkovao sam, dakle apetita još ima.

nodes.source: It's the Cirque du Soliel show night tonight in Manchester, going to try to conserve my energy all day today, so I can feel good for the journey to Manchester and enjoy the show.
nodes.text: Večeras idemo na predstavu Cirque du Soleil u Manchesteru. Pokušat ću cijeli dan štedjeti snagu kako bih se dobro osjećao za put i mogao uživati u predstavi.

nodes.source: Arrived at The Trafford Centre in good time for the show, feeling OK. I got a sneak look at the Trafford shopping centre, never been there before; quite impressed! I'll have to pay it a visit when I'm better.
nodes.text: U Trafford Centre stigli smo dovoljno rano, a ja sam se osjećao dobro. Nakratko sam razgledao trgovački centar Trafford, gdje dotad nisam bio. Prilično me impresionirao! Morat ću ga ponovno posjetiti kad ozdravim.

nodes.source: The show was fantastic (as expected), I enjoyed every minute of it and was glad that, although tough, I had made the effort to visit my friends and go to the show (with a little help from them of course).
nodes.text: Predstava je bila fantastična, kao što sam očekivao. Uživao sam u svakoj minuti i bilo mi je drago što sam, iako je bilo teško, uložio trud da posjetim prijatelje i odem na predstavu, naravno uz njihovu pomoć.

nodes.source: Once back to Leeds, I was soon ready for bed. I found the whole thing quite tiring.
nodes.text: Kad smo se vratili u Leeds, ubrzo sam bio spreman za krevet. Sve me to poprilično iscrpilo.

nodes.source: 13th February 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 13. veljače 2005. - nedjelja

nodes.source: Woke up at 06:00 feeling nauseous; managed to ignore the feeling and get some more sleep. Once I got up, it wasn't long before I was sick. Strange, as I had only been feeling tired over the preceding days. I think it might be something to do with the fact that I ate a whole box of popcorn the night before. Oh and half a bag of liquorice!
nodes.text: Probudio sam se u šest ujutro s mučninom, ali uspio sam je ignorirati i još malo zaspati. Kad sam ustao, nije dugo prošlo prije nego što sam povratio. Čudno jer sam prethodnih dana osjećao uglavnom samo umor. Mislim da je možda zbog cijele kutije kokica koju sam pojeo sinoć. Ah da, i pola vrećice sladića!

nodes.source: Once up and about, I didn't really fancy any food at all and just curled up in my chair and watched the box.
nodes.text: Kad sam ustao, hrana mi uopće nije bila primamljiva pa sam se sklupčao u naslonjaču i gledao televiziju.

nodes.source: My Aunt and Uncle paid me a visit and saw me change from feeling quite sick to perking up quite a bit. I was sick again in the afternoon; felt a lot better after. Soon after they left I started to feel tired again and had some doubt whether I would make my flight home.
nodes.text: Posjetili su me teta i stric i vidjeli kako se iz prilično bolesnog čovjeka pretvaram u nekoga kome je znatno bolje. Poslijepodne sam opet povratio i nakon toga se osjećao mnogo bolje. Nedugo nakon njihova odlaska ponovno sam se umorio i posumnjao hoću li uspjeti na let kući.

nodes.source: Had a sleep for an hour or so and pushed myself to get packed and ready for the flight. All day I had only managed some water, Lucozade and a sliced apple, as I just didn't feel right at all.
nodes.text: Odspavao sam oko sat vremena i natjerao se spakirati i pripremiti za let. Cijeli dan uspio sam popiti samo malo vode i Lucozade te pojesti narezanu jabuku, jer se uopće nisam osjećao kako treba.

nodes.source: I had a great but relaxed weekend with some very caring and close friends. It was hard for me to say good-bye at the airport, I could have cried easily. I had such a nice time and also did not want to face what I knew I was coming back to.
nodes.text: Proveo sam krasan, miran vikend s vrlo brižnim i bliskim prijateljima. Bilo mi je teško oprostiti se u zračnoj luci, lako sam mogao zaplakati. Bilo mi je tako lijepo, a nisam se želio ni vratiti onome što sam znao da me čeka.

nodes.source: I was soon up in the clouds and headed for Heathrow. Ken was there waiting to pick me up and I was ready for and waiting to hit my bed. I was exhausted.
nodes.text: Ubrzo sam bio među oblacima na putu za Heathrow. Ken me čekao da me odveze kući, a ja sam jedva čekao leći u krevet. Bio sam potpuno iscrpljen.

nodes.source: 14th February 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 14. veljače 2005. - ponedjeljak

nodes.source: Woke up feeling OK. Lazed around for a bit then got up and got myself some breakfast. At least my appetite has returned.
nodes.text: Probudio sam se osjećajući se dobro. Još sam malo ljenčario pa ustao i pripremio doručak. Barem mi se apetit vratio.

nodes.source: Still lazed around, taking it very easy as I'm still getting tired out quite quickly. Tomorrow's blood test will most likely confirm my red blood count and haemoglobin levels are still low. This could possibly mean a requirement for a blood transfusion sometime this week. I'm not really keen on it, not sure why, it just doesn't appeal to me!
nodes.text: I dalje se odmaram i ništa ne forsiram jer se brzo umaram. Sutrašnja krvna slika vjerojatno će potvrditi da su broj crvenih krvnih stanica i hemoglobin još niski, što bi moglo značiti transfuziju tijekom tjedna. Nije mi baš draga ta ideja, ne znam zašto, jednostavno me ne privlači!

nodes.source: Time to reflect on my weekend away today, like I said a brilliant time but I certainly pushed myself to get there, be on my best and get back! I still think I needed to get away, so I'm really glad I did it.
nodes.text: Danas razmišljam o vikendu koji sam proveo daleko od kuće. Kao što sam rekao, bilo je sjajno, ali morao sam se jako potruditi da odem, budem u formi i vratim se! I dalje mislim da mi je trebao taj predah i drago mi je što sam otišao.

nodes.source: It also occurred to me today that the 2 month marker - since I was diagnosed - escaped a mention in my diary on the 9th of this month. Time has passed so quickly recently; I've been tired, fed up and I have so much ahead of me with extra operations being mentioned and blood transfusions, my mind is all over the place.
nodes.text: Danas sam se sjetio da je dvomjesečna obljetnica dijagnoze, 9. veljače, prošla bez spomena u dnevniku. Vrijeme je posljednjih dana nevjerojatno brzo proletjelo. Umoran sam i svega mi je dosta, a još me toliko toga čeka, spominju se dodatne operacije i transfuzije krvi. Misli su mi potpuno zbrkane.

nodes.source: The day soon flashed by, once I'd had a long bath I was ready for an evening in front of the box.
nodes.text: Dan je brzo prošao. Nakon dugog kupanja bio sam spreman za večer pred televizorom.

nodes.source: Had a light dinner of soup and bread, I haven't really eaten as well as I should have but my tiredness doesn't allow me much energy to do anything else.
nodes.text: Za večeru sam pojeo laganu juhu i kruh. Ne jedem toliko dobro koliko bih trebao, ali umor mi oduzima snagu za bilo što drugo.

nodes.source: Ready to hit the sack soon, hospital tomorrow and the apprehension is building already. I'm getting fed up with it, but I have no choice, so soldiering on is my only option.
nodes.text: Uskoro sam spreman za krevet. Sutra je opet bolnica i već osjećam sve veću strepnju. Dosta mi je svega, ali nemam izbora. Ostaje mi samo nastaviti dalje.

nodes.source: It has been a hectic weekend and I've not been feeling great, apologies for those of you that missed out on my regular diary updates. Oh, and in case you were wondering, I didn't get any Valentines, nor did I send any!!
nodes.text: Iza mene je naporan vikend i nisam se osjećao najbolje. Ispričavam se svima koji su propustili redovite zapise u dnevniku. Ah, i ako ste se pitali, nisam dobio nijednu čestitku za Valentinovo, niti sam ikome poslao!!

nodes.source: 15th February 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 15. veljače 2005. - utorak

nodes.source: Woke up feeling OK, although still tired. After a palaver in the bathroom with a nose bleed, a painful experience on the loo and feeling exhausted, I finally got myself together for the hospital.
nodes.text: Probudio sam se dobro, premda još umoran. Nakon zbrke u kupaonici zbog krvarenja iz nosa, bolnog odlaska na zahod i iscrpljenosti, napokon sam se spremio za bolnicu.

nodes.source: Once I arrived at hospital, pretty much the same happened as the previous Tuesday. I was late and told that my treatment could not be carried out until tomorrow. A blood test was taken and I waited just over an hour for the results to come through.
nodes.text: Kad sam stigao, ponovilo se gotovo isto što i prošlog utorka. Zakasnio sam i rekli su mi da terapija mora pričekati do sutra. Izvadili su mi krv i čekao sam nešto više od sat vremena na nalaze.

nodes.source: Everything at an all time low today: neutrophils, platelets, red blood count and haemoglobin levels. This means 3 more GCSF injections at the end of the week, beginning Thursday. Bleomycin chemotherapy treatment tomorrow and, more significantly, I am to take on 2 units of blood on Thursday.
nodes.text: Danas su sve vrijednosti na najnižoj razini dosad: neutrofili, trombociti, broj crvenih krvnih stanica i hemoglobin. To znači još tri G-CSF injekcije krajem tjedna, počevši od četvrtka. Sutra me čeka kemoterapija bleomicinom, a još važnije, u četvrtak moram primiti dvije jedinice krvi.

nodes.source: Made my way home feeling tired and washed out. Not looking forward to tomorrow.
nodes.text: Krenuo sam kući umoran i potpuno iscrpljen. Ne veselim se sutrašnjem danu.

nodes.source: I wanted to go and see my Mum this evening but was just too tired to make it over to her house.
nodes.text: Večeras sam želio posjetiti mamu, ali bio sam preumoran da odem do nje.

nodes.source: Watched the box for a bit and retired to bed with my heart beating fast if I so much as moved a little.
nodes.text: Malo sam gledao televiziju pa otišao spavati. Srce mi je ubrzano tuklo čim bih se samo malo pomaknuo.

nodes.source: 16th February 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 16. veljače 2005. - srijeda

nodes.source: Woke up feeling OK, although still tired. After another nose bleed and, feeling exhausted, I finally got myself together for the hospital.
nodes.text: Probudio sam se dobro, premda još umoran. Nakon još jednog krvarenja iz nosa i osjećaja iscrpljenosti, napokon sam se spremio za bolnicu.

nodes.source: Once I arrived at the hospital, I was soon connected up for treatment. I didn't feel too bad and managed to stay quite lucid today, a big difference from last week's treatment.
nodes.text: Kad sam stigao, ubrzo su me priključili na terapiju. Nisam se osjećao pretjerano loše i danas sam uspio ostati prilično priseban, što je velika razlika u odnosu na prošlotjedno liječenje.

nodes.source: Had a big Subway sandwich for lunch, didn't fancy any of the hospital stuff and Ken collected it for me while he was out in Hammersmith. It was certainly a large sandwich so I made it last throughout the day. Experienced a bit of a stomach ache late afternoon. Not quite sure what this could be related to, could be the chemotherapy, could be the anti-sickness drugs or could be the sandwich!
nodes.text: Za ručak sam imao golem sendvič iz Subwaya. Bolnička hrana mi nije bila primamljiva pa ga je Ken donio iz Hammersmitha dok je bio vani. Bio je toliko velik da sam ga jeo cijeli dan. Kasno poslijepodne dobio sam bolove u trbuhu. Ne znam jesu li od kemoterapije, lijekova protiv mučnine ili sendviča!

nodes.source: By the end of the day, I was really starting to feel the side effects of the chemotherapy. Shivering and chills were the order of the day. Once I managed to get to the car, my teeth were chattering despite me being wrapped up really warm. The stomach ache was quite chronic at times.
nodes.text: Pred kraj dana stvarno sam počeo osjećati nuspojave kemoterapije. Tresavica i zimica obilježile su ostatak dana. Kad sam napokon stigao do auta, zubi su mi cvokotali unatoč tome što sam bio dobro utopljen. Bolovi u trbuhu ponekad su bili vrlo jaki.

nodes.source: My heart beat was very noticeable, too. I could hear every thrust of my heart and feel it all over my body. Due to my reduced red blood count and haemoglobin levels, my heart was compensating for the lack of oxygen being carried around my body by pumping harder and faster.
nodes.text: Otkucaji srca također su mi bili jako izraženi. Čuo sam svaki udarac i osjećao ga kroz cijelo tijelo. Zbog smanjenog broja crvenih krvnih stanica i hemoglobina srce je nadoknađivalo manjak kisika koji krv prenosi tako što je pumpalo snažnije i brže.

nodes.source: Reaching home, I was in a terrible state and hit the sofa, still with my coat on and covered myself with a duvet. After some sofa sleep I managed to get myself up to bed, my heart still racing. I could hardly breathe or see properly.
nodes.text: Kad sam došao kući, bio sam u groznom stanju. Srušio sam se na kauč, još u kaputu, i pokrio poplunom. Nakon malo sna na kauču uspio sam se odvući u krevet, ali srce je i dalje jurilo. Jedva sam mogao disati ili jasno vidjeti.

nodes.source: I think some anxiety was mixed in to my state and I just couldn't get to sleep with the beating noise and rushing of blood in my body. Ken checked my stats (with a heart rate monitor I have) and my temperature; all seemed within tolerable limits and things settled a little for me to get off to sleep.
nodes.text: Mislim da se svemu pridružila i tjeskoba. Nisam mogao zaspati od lupanja srca i šuma krvi kroz tijelo. Ken mi je izmjerio vitalne vrijednosti uređajem za praćenje pulsa koji imam te temperaturu. Sve je bilo unutar podnošljivih granica i stanje se malo smirilo pa sam uspio zaspati.

nodes.source: 17th February 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 17. veljače 2005. - četvrtak

nodes.source: Woke up heart still beating fast; no time for anything this morning, so I just got ready in my poorly state and set off for the hospital. En route to the hospital today, I could hardly hold back the tears as I have just about had enough of all of this treatment, needles and hassle. Totally fed up is the feeling. I can see the light at the end of the tunnel but I'm rapidly nearing the end of my tether.
nodes.text: Probudio sam se sa srcem koje je i dalje prebrzo tuklo. Jutros nisam imao vremena ni za što, samo sam se u svom jadnom stanju spremio i krenuo u bolnicu. Na putu sam jedva zadržavao suze. Gotovo mi je dosta svega: terapija, igala i svih muka. Posve mi je dozlogrdilo. Vidim svjetlo na kraju tunela, ali brzo dolazim do kraja svojih snaga.

nodes.source: So many ailments to cope with, along with the constant battering of treatment, is certainly dragging me down. I hope it will soon be over and I will be given a break to get back to full strength. My body has been ravaged by this cancer, now beaten into submission by the chemotherapy. The benefits of the chemotherapy far outweigh the side effects, it's just becoming a lot harder to deal with these days.
nodes.text: Toliko tegoba uz neprestano iscrpljivanje liječenjem doista me vuče prema dolje. Nadam se da će uskoro završiti i da ću dobiti predah kako bih se potpuno oporavio. Rak je opustošio moje tijelo, a kemoterapija ga sada dodatno iscrpljuje. Dobrobiti kemoterapije neusporedivo su veće od nuspojava, samo što ih je iz dana u dan sve teže podnositi.

nodes.source: I never anticipated or had been told at the beginning that there was a possibility of having a blood transfusion, despite it being a common treatment with chemotherapy patients. Typical of me to have a rare blood group, in fact the third rarest in the country according to the National Blood Service. I am AB+, this doesn't cause any problem, it's just there's not so much of it around as other more common blood types.
nodes.text: Na početku nisam očekivao niti su mi rekli da bih mogao trebati transfuziju krvi, iako je to uobičajeno kod pacijenata na kemoterapiji. Tipično za mene da imam rijetku krvnu grupu, zapravo treću najrjeđu u zemlji prema Nacionalnoj transfuzijskoj službi. Moja grupa je AB+, što nije problem, samo je ima mnogo manje od češćih skupina.

nodes.source: Arrived at the hospital, still very washed out, heart beating fast, stomach mildly aching, exhausted and feeling quite upset. I managed to hold back the tears and got on with the events of the day.
nodes.text: U bolnicu sam stigao još uvijek blijed i iscrpljen, uz ubrzano lupanje srca, blagu bol u trbuhu, veliki umor i dosta tuge. Uspio sam zadržati suze i krenuti u dnevne obaveze.

nodes.source: I was soon hooked up and the blood transfusion begun. No IV machine is used (it can damage the blood), the blood is kind of free flowed straight from the bag but slightly restricted to about one drip every two seconds. I had two bags of AB+ (about 600ml, just over a pint) specifically cross-matched. All arranged blood transfusions are. It took around 4-5 hours and I certainly felt a lot better at the end of it.
nodes.text: Ubrzo su me priključili i transfuzija je počela. Ne koristi se infuzijski aparat jer može oštetiti krv; krv slobodno teče iz vrećice, uz ograničenje otprilike jedne kapi svake dvije sekunde. Imao sam dvije posebno podudarene vrećice krvi AB+, oko 600 mililitara, nešto više od jedne pinte. Tako se provjerava svaka planirana transfuzija. Trajala je četiri do pet sati i nakon nje sam se osjećao mnogo bolje.

nodes.source: If I am to suffer any side effects, they would be apparent quite quickly. My temperature and stats were checked regularly and all went smoothly.
nodes.text: Ako se pojave nuspojave, trebale bi se pokazati vrlo brzo. Redovito su mi mjerili temperaturu i vitalne znakove i sve je prošlo glatko.

nodes.source: Ken and I visited my favourite juice bar at Planet Organic in north London afterwards for a healthy smoothie and a shot of wheat grass! My stomach ache is still apparent but seems better.
nodes.text: Ken i ja poslije smo posjetili moj omiljeni bar sa sokovima u Planet Organic u sjevernom Londonu, popili zdrav smoothie i mali sok od pšenične trave! Trbuh me još boli, ali čini se malo manje.

nodes.source: Now I'm home and looking forward to my final three days break. I'm feeling hungry so I'll have to conjure something up tonight. My Dad was due to visit but is not too well himself, flu, and I cannot be exposed to that.
nodes.text: Sad sam kod kuće i veselim se posljednja tri dana predaha. Gladan sam, pa ću večeras morati nešto smisliti za jelo. Tata je trebao doći, ali i sam je bolestan, ima gripu, a ja joj se ne smijem izlagati.

nodes.source: Over the past few days, and especially since my Wednesday chemotherapy, my chest seems to ache quite a bit, possibly my lungs reacting to the recent chemotherapy or the fact that my blood levels were at an all time low.
nodes.text: Posljednjih dana, osobito nakon srijede i kemoterapije, prsa me dosta bole. Možda pluća reagiraju na nedavno liječenje, a možda je uzrok činjenica da mi je krvna slika bila na najnižim vrijednostima dosad.

nodes.source: The transfusion today should perk me up quite a bit so, thanks to some kind soul giving some of their rare blood, I am to feel better quite soon and now understand the National Blood Services advert when they say "thanks to this person my relative's life was saved during their chemotherapy". Thanks whoever you are!
nodes.text: Današnja transfuzija trebala bi me prilično podići. Zahvaljujući nekoj dobroj duši koja je darovala svoju rijetku krv, uskoro bih se trebao osjećati bolje. Sada shvaćam reklamu Nacionalne transfuzijske službe u kojoj ljudi kažu da je zahvaljujući darivatelju njihovoj rodbini spašen život tijekom kemoterapije. Hvala ti, tko god da si!

nodes.source: 18th February 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 18. veljače 2005. - petak

nodes.source: Woke up after a weird night's sleep. Got to bed at about midnight. My back and chest (lungs?) were aching quite substantially last night.
nodes.text: Probudio sam se nakon neobične noći. Legao sam oko ponoći. Sinoć su me leđa i prsa, odnosno pluća, poprilično boljela.

nodes.source: After dinner I managed to pop out briefly to surprise my Mum as she was out in a quiet local pub with my brother (thanks Martin). She was really surprised to see me turn up to have a quick soft drink with her and it made all the difference to me and I'm sure her spirits, too.
nodes.text: Poslije večere uspio sam nakratko izići i iznenaditi mamu, koja je s bratom sjedila u mirnom lokalnom pubu (hvala, Martine). Jako se iznenadila kad sam se pojavio na kratkom bezalkoholnom piću. To je mnogo značilo i meni, a siguran sam i njoj.

nodes.source: Last night was weird. When I went to bed my back was aching quite severely, right at the bottom of my spine and it felt like it was deep inside the bone. I could hardly get off to sleep and awoke at 02.30 in excruciating pain. I had to take 2 paracetamols and, once the pain was suppressed, I drifted off to sleep. Woke up several times after that, sweating badly. All in all, not a brilliant night's sleep, however I am feeling reasonably OK today.
nodes.text: Sinoć je bilo čudno. Kad sam legao, leđa su me vrlo jako boljela pri samom dnu kralježnice, kao da bol dolazi iz dubine kosti. Jedva sam zaspao, a u 2:30 probudio sam se u nepodnošljivim bolovima. Morao sam uzeti dvije tablete paracetamola i, kad je bol popustila, ponovno sam zaspao. Poslije sam se nekoliko puta budio, sav obliven znojem. Sve u svemu, loša noć, premda se danas osjećam razmjerno dobro.

nodes.source: The blood transfusion has obviously done a good job as I certainly feel a bit closer to normal again, certainly versus the last few days. I've had a very lazy morning and enjoyed a large bowl of cereal for breakfast.
nodes.text: Transfuzija je očito pomogla jer se ponovno osjećam mnogo bliže normalnom stanju nego posljednjih dana. Imao sam vrlo lijeno jutro i uživao u velikoj zdjeli žitarica za doručak.

nodes.source: I'll take it easy today, I fancy getting out a bit later so will eat well and have a long overdue relaxing bath before I decide what to do.
nodes.text: Danas ću se štedjeti. Volio bih kasnije malo izići pa ću dobro jesti i okupati se kako treba, što već dugo nisam, prije nego što odlučim što ću dalje.

nodes.source: Didn't feel like doing anything today so lounged around after my bath. Ate some lunch then some soup for dinner because I just didn't have the energy for anything else.
nodes.text: Danas mi se ipak ništa nije dalo, pa sam se nakon kupanja izležavao. Pojeo sam ručak, a za večeru juhu jer nisam imao snage ni za što drugo.

nodes.source: Just have to postpone what I wanted to do today until tomorrow. As long as I can conjure up the energy!
nodes.text: Ono što sam planirao za danas moram odgoditi do sutra, ako uspijem skupiti snagu!

nodes.source: Going to bed very soon!
nodes.text: Uskoro idem u krevet!

nodes.source: 19th February 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 19. veljače 2005. - subota

nodes.source: Last night's sleep wasn't bad although I did wake up once, suddenly, in the early hours. No idea what that was about.
nodes.text: Sinoć sam spavao sasvim pristojno, iako sam se jednom naglo probudio u ranim jutarnjim satima. Nemam pojma zašto.

nodes.source: A bit sluggish this morning, but managed to get moving and arranged with a friend to take a drive to visit the Masonic shop in Great Queen Street, London. Quite a journey for me! Picked up some bits for an important ceremony on the 26th, one day after my upcoming treatment. I hope to be there!!
nodes.text: Jutros sam bio malo trom, ali uspio sam se pokrenuti i dogovorio se s prijateljem da se odvezemo do masonske trgovine u Great Queen Streetu u Londonu. Za mene je to poprilično putovanje! Kupio sam nekoliko stvari za važnu ceremoniju 26. veljače, dan nakon predstojeće terapije. Nadam se da ću moći prisustvovati!!

nodes.source: Made my way back, with a quick visit to B&Q and McDonalds. Sat around at my friend's house for a while then head for home briefly before setting off to see my Mum for the evening.
nodes.text: Vratili smo se uz brzi posjet B&Q-u i McDonald'su. Neko sam vrijeme sjedio kod prijatelja, nakratko se vratio kući, a zatim krenuo provesti večer kod mame.

nodes.source: A hectic day by my current standards, but I achieved all I needed and should sleep well tonight. I haven't managed to eat a very healthy dinner tonight, I'm out of energy and am home quite late. Soup again!
nodes.text: Prema mojim sadašnjim mjerilima bio je to vrlo naporan dan, ali obavio sam sve što sam trebao i večeras bih trebao dobro spavati. Nisam stigao pojesti posebno zdravu večeru; ostao sam bez snage i kući došao prilično kasno. Opet juha!

nodes.source: All in all, a good day, although tiring. I just don't seem to have the energy I used to have and am certainly feeling weaker in my arms and legs. No wonder, when I haven't really done much at all in the last 2 and a half months!
nodes.text: Sve u svemu, dobar, ali naporan dan. Jednostavno više nemam energije kao prije i definitivno osjećam slabost u rukama i nogama. Nije ni čudo kad posljednja dva i pol mjeseca nisam gotovo ništa radio!

nodes.source: 20th February 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 20. veljače 2005. - nedjelja

nodes.source: From today the following entries were not made in this diary until the 15th March 2005, due to circumstances that will become apparent as you read on...
nodes.text: Od danas sljedeći zapisi nisu uneseni u dnevnik sve do 15. ožujka 2005. iz razloga koji će vam postati jasni kako budete čitali...

nodes.source: A good sleep and once up I made arrangements to have Sunday lunch with my friend at his Mum's house.
nodes.text: Dobro sam spavao i nakon ustajanja dogovorio nedjeljni ručak s prijateljem kod njegove mame.

nodes.source: Time soon passed and I was at my friend's Mum's for dinner, she's 75 and certainly cooks a mean Sunday roast which I thoroughly enjoyed along with a massive fruit salad for afters, yummy.
nodes.text: Vrijeme je brzo prošlo i ubrzo sam bio kod prijateljeve mame na ručku. Ima 75 godina i sprema izvrsno nedjeljno pečenje u kojem sam jako uživao, uz golemu voćnu salatu za desert. Njam.

nodes.source: Over to my Mum's to spend time with her before my 5 day stay in hospital beginning tomorrow. Picked up some clean clothes I needed and headed home apprehensively, fighting hospital thoughts from my head!
nodes.text: Otišao sam mami kako bih proveo malo vremena s njom prije petodnevnog boravka u bolnici koji počinje sutra. Pokupio sam čistu odjeću koja mi je trebala i s nelagodom krenuo kući, pokušavajući otjerati misli na bolnicu!

nodes.source: 21st February 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 21. veljače 2005. - ponedjeljak

nodes.source: Arrived at hospital in good time today. I know the routine, so got my general admission out of the way, blood test and X-Ray.
nodes.text: Danas sam u bolnicu stigao na vrijeme. Znam postupak pa sam brzo obavio prijam, vađenje krvi i rendgen.

nodes.source: Met up with Milton and nipped over the road for a Pizza Express with him and Ken. Straight back to hospital afterwards and awaited my cannulation and treatment start time.
nodes.text: Našao sam se s Miltonom pa smo on, Ken i ja otišli preko puta u Pizza Express. Odmah smo se vratili u bolnicu i čekali postavljanje kanile i početak liječenja.

nodes.source: Confirmation came today about my final treatment cycle, the Bleomycin chemotherapy drug was to be cut out of my schedule. My lungs have shown significant improvement (the cancer cells have shrunk to almost non existent). Any more of the 'B' part of my treatment would only damage my lungs further. So this is my FINAL week of chemotherapy, no more required, no outpatient chemotherapy visits anymore. A sobering thought and certainly something to focus on as a positive landmark in my overall treatment. Having goals, however small, has helped make things easier going throughout and almost sped up the times I've wanted to forget about so quickly!
nodes.text: Danas je potvrđeno što će biti s posljednjim ciklusom liječenja: bleomicin se izbacuje iz mojeg rasporeda. Pluća su mi znatno bolje, stanice raka smanjile su se gotovo do nestanka. Dodatni 'B' dio liječenja samo bi još više oštetio pluća. Dakle, ovo je moj POSLJEDNJI tjedan kemoterapije. Nema više potrebnih ciklusa ni ambulantnih dolazaka na kemoterapiju. Vrlo značajna misao i pozitivan prekretnica u cijelom liječenju. Imati ciljeve, koliko god male, olakšavalo mi je put i gotovo ubrzavalo vrijeme koje sam tako želio zaboraviti!

nodes.source: Treatment began quite late however, due to the 'B' part of my chemotherapy being cut out, it would only mean 9 hours of treatment each day.
nodes.text: Liječenje je počelo dosta kasno, ali budući da je dio s bleomicinom izbačen, svakoga će dana trajati samo devet sati.

nodes.source: Not much sleep tonight, being a veteran of chemotherapy, 3 full cycles previous, I was used to this and handled it in my stride!
nodes.text: Sinoć nisam mnogo spavao, ali već sam veteran kemoterapije s tri puna ciklusa iza sebe pa sam na to navikao i podnosio bez velike drame!

nodes.source: 22nd February 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 22. veljače 2005. - utorak

nodes.source: Free of my IV machine in the early hours of this morning, I managed to get up and about for a bit today. I notified the nurses of a time that would suit me to begin my next treatment. They were happy to do this and I made best use of the time I had to myself.
nodes.text: U ranim jutarnjim satima skinuli su me s infuzijskog aparata i danas sam se uspio malo kretati. Medicinskim sestrama rekao sam kada bi mi odgovaralo početi sljedeću terapiju. Pristale su pa sam slobodno vrijeme dobro iskoristio.

nodes.source: This evening, I started to get nauseous and the chemotherapy was starting to take its toll on me a lot earlier than I had remembered from previous weeks.
nodes.text: Večeras mi je počelo biti mučno, a kemoterapija je počela uzimati danak mnogo ranije nego što se sjećam iz prethodnih tjedana.

nodes.source: 23rd February 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 23. veljače 2005. - srijeda

nodes.source: Woke up free from IV again, a slightly better night's sleep but chemotherapy still did not end until the early hours. Sleep certainly does not seem to be important in terms of treatment in hospital, I always thought that it was the time that your body rejuvenated and recovered best!?
nodes.text: Probudio sam se opet bez infuzije. Noć je bila malo bolja, iako je kemoterapija završila tek u ranim jutarnjim satima. U bolnici san očito nije važan dio liječenja. Oduvijek sam mislio da se upravo dok spavamo tijelo najbolje obnavlja i oporavlja!?

nodes.source: Still feeling extremely nauseous today.
nodes.text: Danas mi je i dalje izuzetno mučno.

nodes.source: I was asked if I could be a dummy patient, like an actor in a given situation. As this helps to pass the time of day in an interesting manner, I readily agreed. I was to be told -hypothetically of course- that I was Hepatitis C positive by a trainee doctor who needed to practise their patient communication skills before an exam.
nodes.text: Pitali su me bih li glumio pacijenta u vježbi, poput glumca u zadanoj situaciji. Kako mi to zanimljivo skraćuje dan, rado sam pristao. Liječnik na edukaciji trebao mi je, naravno hipotetski, priopćiti da sam pozitivan na hepatitis C. Vježbao je komunikaciju s pacijentima prije ispita.

nodes.source: It was fun (I don't think in reality it would be much fun) playing the part and to be honest the news was broken to me a little bit abruptly and could have been a little smoother. I asked all the questions I think someone in my given situation would do in order to make it as real as possible for the trainee.
nodes.text: Bilo je zabavno glumiti, premda u stvarnosti sigurno ne bi bilo zabavno. Moram priznati da mi je vijest izrečena malo previše naglo i mogla je biti obzirnije priopćena. Postavljao sam sva pitanja koja bi, vjerujem, postavio netko u toj situaciji kako bi vježba bila što stvarnija.

nodes.source: I retired to bed shortly after. I haven't eaten much at all so far, Monday was the last day I really ate a decent meal. The sheer thought of treatment, the environment, the smells, everything makes me feel sick!
nodes.text: Nedugo zatim povukao sam se u krevet. Dosad gotovo ništa nisam jeo; ponedjeljak je bio posljednji dan kad sam imao pristojan obrok. Sama pomisao na liječenje, okruženje i mirise, sve mi izaziva mučninu!

nodes.source: Ken has visited from late afternoon onwards. Having someone around makes a great difference to time spent in hospital. I am very lucky to have had people I know around me most of the time. Other patients look lonely and left without visitors for days, perhaps it's what they wanted; I know I would have certainly felt a void if faced with the time on my own.
nodes.text: Ken je ovdje od kasnog poslijepodneva. Prisutnost druge osobe čini veliku razliku dok si u bolnici. Imam veliku sreću što su većinu vremena oko mene ljudi koje poznajem. Drugi pacijenti djeluju usamljeno i danima nemaju posjetitelja; možda to žele, ali znam da bih ja osjećao veliku prazninu kad bih sve to prolazio sam.

nodes.source: chemotherapy started a little after the time I requested. Another "into the night" treatment schedule ahead.
nodes.text: Kemoterapija je počela malo kasnije od vremena koje sam tražio. Preda mnom je još jedna terapija koja će trajati duboko u noć.

nodes.source: Stayed in bed for the rest of the day and, in the evening, managed some water melon Ken had brought along. It didn't stay down for long, I will not go into detail!
nodes.text: Ostatak dana proveo sam u krevetu, a navečer uspio pojesti malo lubenice koju je Ken donio. Nije se dugo zadržala u želucu. Neću u pojedinosti!

nodes.source: 24th February 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 24. veljače 2005. - četvrtak

nodes.source: Another late chemotherapy finish (early hours). Nausea much, much more apparent today and retching with sickness was the order of the day. The anti sickness drugs are not working so well for me this week, most likely to do with the fact that I cannot keep even them down for long.
nodes.text: Još jedan kasni završetak kemoterapije, u ranim jutarnjim satima. Mučnina je danas mnogo, mnogo izraženija i cijeli dan povraćam i napinjem se. Lijekovi protiv mučnine ovaj tjedan ne djeluju baš dobro, vjerojatno zato što ih ni same ne mogu dugo zadržati u želucu.

nodes.source: Stayed in bed all day, getting up only to visit the loo. Being sick wasn't pleasant with nothing inside me to actually be sick with, my only comfort being that I didn't have to jump up and run for the loo; I had stocked up on the cardboard throw away hospital sickness bowls!
nodes.text: Cijeli dan proveo sam u krevetu, ustajući samo do zahoda. Povraćanje nije ugodno kad nemaš ništa u želucu. Jedina utjeha bila mi je što nisam morao trčati na zahod jer sam se opskrbio kartonskim bolničkim posudama za povraćanje!

nodes.source: I did manage 2 bowls of cornflakes without milk tonight. It was really the only thing I could think of that I fancied and they actually stayed inside me somewhere never to be seen again!
nodes.text: Večeras sam ipak uspio pojesti dvije zdjele kukuruznih pahuljica bez mlijeka. To je bilo jedino što sam mogao zamisliti da mi se jede i doista su se zadržale negdje u meni, bez povratka!

nodes.source: Late start on the chemotherapy again, slightly later than I had requested but earlier than previous days, my first decent night's sleep was due. This slightly comforting thought was soon demolished as chemotherapy bag changes and delays (the nurses were extremely busy today and low in numbers) took my chemotherapy completion in to the early hours again.
nodes.text: Kemoterapija je opet počela kasno, malo kasnije nego što sam tražio, ali ranije nego prijašnjih dana. Već sam se veselio prvoj pristojnoj noći sna. Ta se utješna misao brzo raspršila jer su promjene vrećica i kašnjenja, sestre su bile iznimno zaposlene i bilo ih je premalo, ponovno odgodile kraj terapije do ranog jutra.

nodes.source: 25th February 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 25. veljače 2005. - petak

nodes.source: My last chemotherapy day. A wonderful thought but I had no energy and felt so sick I could hardly break a smile.
nodes.text: Moj posljednji dan kemoterapije. Divna pomisao, ali nisam imao snage, a bilo mi je toliko mučno da sam se jedva mogao nasmiješiti.

nodes.source: Another day in bed, my friend came early today and kept my spirits up although I did sleep quite a bit so wasn't much company in return. In fact on reflection sleep was definitely a regular occurrence during the days this week, catching the odd hour here and there whenever I could.
nodes.text: Još jedan dan u krevetu. Prijateljica je danas došla rano i podizala mi raspoloženje, premda sam dosta spavao pa joj nisam bio neko društvo. Kad razmislim, spavanje je tijekom cijelog tjedna bilo redovita pojava, po sat vremena kad god bih mogao.

nodes.source: Chemotherapy started a lot later than I would have liked. 6 West was a very busy ward this week and rumours were rife that it was to stay open for the weekend. Well I never, what a turn up for the books, I remember a time when I was the only patient left on the ward and they couldn't wait to get rid of me. Today I was even offered an extra night in the hospital if I wanted. What do you think I said to that? This was possibly to be the last ever day I had to spend in hospital and I couldn't wait to get away!!
nodes.text: Kemoterapija je počela mnogo kasnije nego što sam želio. Odjel 6 West bio je ovaj tjedan vrlo zaposlen i kružile su glasine da će ostati otvoren i tijekom vikenda. Pa to je nešto novo! Sjećam se vremena kad sam bio jedini preostali pacijent i nisu me se mogli dovoljno brzo riješiti. Danas su mi čak ponudili dodatnu noć u bolnici ako želim. Što mislite da sam rekao? Ovo je možda bio posljednji dan koji sam ikada trebao provesti u bolnici i jedva sam čekao otići!!

nodes.source: Finally, chemotherapy finished around 7 or 8pm and after a struggle I was dressed and almost ready to go. One last big heave and I was sick for the last and final time in hospital. I was sick what must have been a record number of times this week, I really do not want to remember how I felt.
nodes.text: Kemoterapija je napokon završila oko 19 ili 20 sati. Uz dosta napora odjenuo sam se i skoro bio spreman za odlazak. Još jednom sam se snažno napnuo i povratio, nadam se posljednji put u bolnici. Ovaj sam tjedan povraćao valjda rekordan broj puta i zaista se ne želim sjećati kako sam se osjećao.

nodes.source: Ken took me home, I fell asleep on the sofa and eventually got up to bed in the early hours.
nodes.text: Ken me odvezao kući. Zaspao sam na kauču pa se naposljetku u ranim jutarnjim satima odselio u krevet.

nodes.source: 26th February 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 26. veljače 2005. - subota

nodes.source: Ken came in to my room to say farewell early this morning as he was off on a short break to see his family for a while. I slept in for a while afterwards.
nodes.text: Ken je rano jutros ušao u sobu pozdraviti se jer je otišao na kratak odmor posjetiti obitelj. Nakon toga još sam neko vrijeme spavao.

nodes.source: So I was up around 12pm and a friend had arrived to look after me and keep me company until Sunday.
nodes.text: Ustao sam oko podneva, a već je stigla prijateljica da me čuva i pravi mi društvo do nedjelje.

nodes.source: Masonic ceremony day today, I really wanted to be able to attend as this was an important goal for me to achieve following my treatment. After all, I had bought all the bits I needed the previous Saturday and somehow had managed to learn some important lines in between being sick and chemotherapy!
nodes.text: Danas je dan masonske ceremonije. Stvarno sam želio sudjelovati jer mi je to bio važan cilj nakon liječenja. Napokon, prethodne subote kupio sam sve što mi treba i nekako naučio važne rečenice između povraćanja i kemoterapije!

nodes.source: Found the energy from somewhere, got myself smartly dressed and left my house around 2.30pm.
nodes.text: Odnekud sam pronašao snagu, lijepo se odjenuo i krenuo iz kuće oko 14:30.

nodes.source: I took it very easy indeed, was extremely glad I had made it out, completed my part of a lengthy ceremony word perfectly and even managed to stay for the meal afterwards. I picked at the food but made a good effort to get some of it inside me.
nodes.text: Sve sam radio vrlo polako i oprezno, ali bio sam presretan što sam uspio otići. Svoj dio duge ceremonije izveo sam bez ijedne pogreške, a čak sam ostao i na obroku nakon toga. Malo sam birao po tanjuru, ali pošteno se potrudio nešto pojesti.

nodes.source: When the meal had finished, I was very tired after a long day and soon went to bed once home.
nodes.text: Kad je obrok završio, bio sam jako umoran nakon dugog dana. Čim sam stigao kući, otišao sam u krevet.

nodes.source: 27th February 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 27. veljače 2005. - nedjelja

nodes.source: Woke up quite early today but soon retired back to bed and didn't get up until about 3pm!!
nodes.text: Danas sam se probudio prilično rano, ali ubrzo sam se vratio u krevet i nisam ustao sve do oko 15 sati!!

nodes.source: Although in and out of sleep for most of the day I managed to watch some TV and, more importantly, eat a little food!
nodes.text: Iako sam gotovo cijeli dan naizmjence spavao i budio se, uspio sam pogledati nešto televizije i, što je važnije, pojesti malo hrane!

nodes.source: My friend decided to stay at my house another night and leave in the morning. My Dad is due to arrive late morning to stay with me for the week ahead.
nodes.text: Prijateljica je odlučila ostati još jednu noć i otići ujutro. Tata bi trebao doći kasno prijepodne i ostati sa mnom cijeli sljedeći tjedan.

nodes.source: Despite sleeping for a good majority of the day, I still felt really tired tonight. Once I made sure my friend had everything she needed and was comfortable I retired to bed for another full night's sleep.
nodes.text: Premda sam prespavao velik dio dana, večeras sam još bio vrlo umoran. Kad sam se pobrinuo da prijateljica ima sve što joj treba i da joj je ugodno, otišao sam na još jednu cijelu noć sna.

nodes.source: 28th February 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 28. veljače 2005. - ponedjeljak

nodes.source: Shortly after getting up, my Dad arrived.
nodes.text: Nedugo nakon što sam ustao, stigao je tata.

nodes.source: Spent the day catching up with my Dad and, although weak, managed to eat a little and start to plan my week ahead, starting with a blood test tomorrow.
nodes.text: Dan sam proveo razgovarajući s tatom i nadoknađujući propušteno. Premda slab, uspio sam malo jesti i početi planirati sljedeći tjedan, počevši sa sutrašnjim vađenjem krvi.

nodes.source: There is so much I want to do but just cannot motivate myself to do it, the truth is I just don't have the energy yet. It annoys me that there are things I want to do but just cannot muster the energy to do them. This chemotherapy in my system is going to take some serious flushing for me to get back to anywhere near normal.
nodes.text: Toliko je toga što želim učiniti, ali jednostavno se ne mogu natjerati. Istina je da još nemam snage. Ljuti me što imam stvari koje želim obaviti, a ne mogu skupiti energije. Trebat će vremena da se sva ta kemoterapija izbaci iz organizma prije nego što se barem približno vratim u normalu.

nodes.source: March 2005
nodes.text: ožujak 2005.

nodes.source: 1st March 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 1. ožujka 2005. - utorak

nodes.source: Got to Charing X about an hour late for my blood test. My Dad accompanied me to the hospital and joined me for a chat with my Doctor. Routine discussions; my treatment has progressed well, now it's recovery time for my body before any operations are carried out.
nodes.text: U Charing Cross stigao sam oko sat vremena kasno na vađenje krvi. Tata je pošao sa mnom i pridružio se razgovoru s liječnikom. Uobičajene teme: liječenje je dobro napredovalo, sad tijelu treba oporavak prije eventualnih operacija.

nodes.source: Spent a considerable amount of time wandering about on the 6th floor catching up with Milton and the staff while waiting for my blood test results. Once they were finally through, I managed to grab the registrar on the 6th floor to discuss them.
nodes.text: Proveo sam dosta vremena lutajući šestim katom, razgovarajući s Miltonom i osobljem dok sam čekao nalaze. Kad su napokon stigli, uhvatio sam liječnika na specijalizaciji na šestom katu da ih prokomentira.
